crossRefs.note: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning Yahweh’s name, she came to test him with hard questions.
He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.
“I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to…
Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with…
for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps…
Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet…
Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?
He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”
He said to them, “Foolish men, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they…

translations.web: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.
translations.bsb: We have much to say about this, but it is hard to explain, because you are dull of hearing.
translations.kjv: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.
translations.asv: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard of interpretation, seeing ye are become dull of hearing.
